checks.name: Cross-consult P1/P2 findings resolved
findings_resolved: F-01: DOM XSS in inspector.js openPopover fixed by replacing innerHTML interpolation of item.selectedText with DOM node construction and .textContent

F-02: SSRF / URL-injection in background.js cfUrl and Ve_sync fixed by enforcing /^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$/ on accountId, validating HTTPS/loopback on custom baseUrl, blocking RFC1918/link-local IPs in Ve_sync, and enforcing extension-origin sender validation

F-03: Scroll/resize listener duplication and active popover destruction in inspector.js fixed by guarding startAnnotationEngine listeners and passing { preservePopover: true } during viewport scroll/resize

F-04: Schema-to-runtime contract alignment across annotation.v1.1.json, inspector.js, panel.js, and background.js (50-property AFS_ALLOWED_PROPS allowlist, unified kind enum, drawingStroke + drawing Data, Apply Fix textContent + CSS sync, formatAfsMarkdown string/object signature)
F-05: Self-Drive concurrency lock (state.selfDriveRunning) and WCAG relative luminance contrast heuristic in inspector.js
F-06: Keyboard accessibility (role='button', tabIndex=0, aria-label, Enter/Space keydown) on AFS floating pins in inspector.js
